summary: Iteration 33: Tested 5 parallel features - Notification Links, Unified Conversation Tab, Notify Client with PDF, RustDesk Remote Access, and Device Discovery. All 29 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend verified with screenshots showing all components working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed route ordering issue: /devices/discover and /devices/scans routes were after /devices/{device_id} dynamic route in server.py. Moved device_discovery router before devices router to ensure proper route matching.
seed_data_creation: None needed - used existing clients, tickets, and devices
context_for_next_testing_agent: 5 features tested and working: 1) Notification bell in sidebar opens dropdown with clickable notifications that navigate to /tickets, /contracts, /devices. 2) Ticket detail has unified 'Conversation' tab (not separate Notes/Emails) with dropdown selector for 'Internal Note' vs 'Public Email'. 3) 'Notify Client' button opens dialog to send email with PDF attachment, 'PDF' button downloads ticket conversation. 4) Client detail has 'Remote' tab with RustDesk device management - add/connect/delete devices. 5) Devices page has 'Discover' button for network scanning with client/subnet selection and one-click import.

notification_links.notes: Notifications dropdown opens, items are clickable, navigate to /tickets, /contracts, /devices based on ref_type

unified_conversation_tab.notes: Single 'Conversation' tab replaces separate Notes/Emails tabs. Dropdown selector switches between 'Internal Note' and 'Public Email'. Timeline shows both notes and emails chronologically.

notify_client_pdf.notes: Notify Client dialog has email/subject/message fields. PDF download generates branded PDF with conversation history. Email sending is in demo mode (Resend API placeholder).

rustdesk_remote_access.notes: Remote tab shows configured RustDesk devices. Add Device form has device_name, rustdesk_id, password, os, notes fields. Connect button opens rustdesk:// URL. Connection is MOCKED (opens protocol handler).

device_discovery.notes: Discovery dialog has client selector and subnet input. Scan returns simulated devices with hostname, IP, MAC, manufacturer, OS, status, response time. Import button adds selected devices. Discovery is MOCKED (simulated network scan).

mocked_apis: Resend email sending (demo mode - placeholder API key)

route_fix_applied.fix: Moved device_discovery router before devices router in server.py all_routers list
